Commentary.Commentary: Now then, the total is a mediocre one and Bangladesh should back themselves to chase this down. Afghanistan though do have the caliber to defend such totals. Can they do so and get back to winning ways or will Bangladesh head into the finals with winning momentum? Stay tuned to find out.

The Bangladesh bowlers did not begin in the best of manners but once again, once the ball got old, scoring became difficult. The spinners managed to not only take wickets in the middle overs but also choke the runs. The pacers too were handy after that. Afif was the pick as he had exceptional figures of 3-1-9-2. He was well supported by the other spinners too.

The story of today for the visitors was quite similar to the one yesterday. Their openers started off in a brilliant manner and added 75 and laid the foundation for a big score. Zazai fell three short of his half ton but ended up as the top scorer for his side. His wicket began the procession as Afghanistan slipped from 75 for 1 to 96 for 5. Not easy to recover after such a collapse in the shorter format. However, the visitors did manage to crawl above the 135-run mark which means they have something to bowl at.

End of another excellent bowling performance by Bangladesh but once again, Afghanistan's middle order fails to capitalize on the start given to them by their openers and hence, it is the hosts which head into the break as the happier side.
Fuller one again, Rashid jams it towards mid-wicket for a single. 9 from the final over as Afghanistan finishes the innings with 138 runs on the board.
Full toss, Shafiqullah goes to paddle it fine down the leg side but can't get it of the middle of the bat. The ball takes the outer half and goes towards cover for a single.
A yorker on the pads, Shafiqullah squeezes it towards deep square leg and takes a quick couple.
FOUR! A much needed boundary. Good length ball around off, Shafiqullah drills it through the cover region and into the fence. He is playing a very important knock.
On middle and a fuller one, Rashid flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! PITCHING OUTSIDE LEG! Rahman bowls a perfect yorker and Rashid looks to reverse sweep it but is nowhere in the position to play it and gets rapped on the pads. Mustafizur appeals as soon as the ball hits the pads but the umpire is unmoved. Shakib consults his bowler and then signals  'T'. The replays roll in and it shows that it's a legal delivery and there is also no spike on the Ultra Edge as the ball went past the bat. The only thing that can save Rashid is where the ball pitched. Hawk Eye comes in and yes the umpire was right as the ball pitched outside leg. Bangladesh lose the review.
Shakib goes for the review after Rashid has been not given out. That looked to be pitching outside leg. Let's see what the replays show.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl the final over of the innings.
Outside off this time, Khan drills it towards long off on the bounce for a single. Just 5 runs from the over. Shafiul finishes with 4-0-24-1.
Outside off, Rashid shuffles across the off stump and lifts it left of the bowler for a couple. That was from the toe-end of the bat and hence couldn't go to the fence.
Fuller on the pads, timed towards long on for a single.
Fuller this time, Rashid whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! Outside off on a good length. Rashid goes for the slog but can't connect. Pretty close to the off stump tramline that one.
Outside off this time, Rashid stays in his crease to paddle it but finds the mid-wicket fielder.

FOUR! What a hit that is. Shafiqullah lays flat on the ground after completing the shot. Saifuddin goes for the yorker but dishes out a low full toss and Shafiqullah paddles it over the short fine leg fielder which goes into the fence for a boundary. Every run is important for Afghanistan. 10 runs from the over.
Yorker on the stumps, Rashid squeezes it to mid on for a single.

What an effort from Liton but he can't hold on. Almost a stunner. This is back of a length ball, Rashid plays it awkwardly towards the off side. Liton flew to his right to take it with one hand but as his hand hits the ground, the ball popped out. Rashid gets a couple.
Full ball on middle, Rashid shuffles across the off side and drills the shot straight to the cover fielder.
Good length ball around off, Rashid drives it past the cover fielder and takes a quick couple. Brilliant running between the wickets.
Brilliant yorker but Shafiqullah does well to push it towards long on for a single.
Khan gets one on the pads and he flicks it to mid-wicket and looks for an unlikely single which is not there. Right call by the non-striker to send his skipper back in time.
Rashid Khan is in now and he needs to score a few quick runs to take Afghanistan towards a decent score.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afghanistan falling like nine pins today. Islam goes short and Janat pulls it  with power to mid-wicket. But he is not able to control the hit and thus fails to go the distance and finds the fielder in the deep mid-wicket region. Good bowling this from Bangladesh bowlers. They are mixing their lines and lengths properly to cause all the troubles to the Afghan batsmen.
Shafiqullah punches this length ball to the off side for a single.
A short one and Janat pulls it away to mid-wicket for a single.

Length and on off, Shafiqullah squeezes it to point and takes off for a quick single. The man at point has a shy at the striker's end only to miss it. Had he hit Janat was a goner as he was nowhere in the frame when the ball went past the stumps at the striker's end.
Shortish ball outside off, Janat slaps it over the point region for a single.
Shafiul Islam is back into the attack.
Nails the yorker again but Shafiqullah gets his bat down in time to jam it. A superb over from Saifuddin, 3 runs and a wicket.
Good length ball around off, driven towards cover for a single.

OUT! Knocks him over with a yorker! What a beauty from Saifuddin! This is a fuller ball around off, Zadran goes to flick it off his toes but misses. The ball goes to hit the off and middle stump. Oh wait, has he overstepped there? They are checking for the no ball. Looks just fine but the third umpire is taking his time. Well, Zadran needs to continue his walk back to the pavilion.
Short ball on middle, does not rise much. Shafiqullah pulls it to mid-wicket to get to the other end.
On a length and on off, Shafiqullah defends it to the off  side.
On a length and outside off, Zadran pushes it to covers and takes a single.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back into the attack. 2-0-10-0 so far.
Flatter one on off, Zadran drives it to long off for a single.
Flatter one on off, Zadran pushes it through covers for a couple.
Zadran defends the flatter one on off to covers.
Fuller one this time, driven firmly towards long off for a single.

SIX! Slogged for a six to get off the mark. What a strike. Flighted delivery around off, Shafiqullah gets into the position and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence. The ball went sailing into the stands.
Around off, Zadran pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Shafiqullah works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter one on middle, Shafiqullah flicks it to the leg side.
Tosses one up and on middle, Shafiqullah sweeps only to find the man at short  fine leg.
Tossed up outside off, Shafiqullah defends it to the leg side.
Shafiqullah is the new man in.

OUT! Brilliant work from Mahmudullah who had dropped a sitter earlier in the innings. A flighted ball on off, Zadran taps it towards point and wants a quick single. Mahmudullah hares at the ball and sends an under arm throw back to the keeper. Mushfiqur collects the ball and whips the bails off to find Naib short of the crease.
A run out appeal taken upstairs by the umpire.
SIX! A much needed one. Full ball around off, Zadran slogs it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Quicker one around off, Zadran drives it towards mid off for a single.
Fuller one this time, Naib pushes it through mid off for a single.
Gulbadin Naib is the next batter in for Afghanistan.

OUT! LBW! A huge wicket for Bangladesh as Nabi could be very destructive. Shakib strikes. He tosses one up and Nabi looks to sweep but is late into the shot and the ball sneaks past the bat to hit him flush on the pads. The umpire raises his finger in a flash as soon as Shakib appeals. Nabi has a chat with his partner about the review but then walks off. Hawk Eye later says Nabi made the right call of not using the DRS as the ball was hitting him in line and going to crash on the leg stump. Afghanistan in deep trouble.
Goes for the reverse sweep this time but can't connect. He is hit on the pads and the ball goes towards square leg for a single. A muted appeal but that was pitching on leg.
A slower one, pushed back to the bowler.

In the air but past the bowler. Flatter ball around off, Nabi looks to work it through mid off but he miscues the shot to the left of Shakib uppishly. He throws his left hand but can't get to the ball. A single taken.
Shakib Al Hasan comes back on. His figures so far 2-0-10-0.
On middle on a fullish length, worked towards mid-wicket for a single. Another tight over from Hossain. Just three runs of it.
Back of a length ball, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, Zadran reverse sweeps it towards point.
Flatter one around off, pushed towards cover.
A flighted ball on middle, Zadran blocks it towards the off side.
Flatter around off, Nabi works it through mid off for a single.
Slightly fuller around off, Nabi drives it towards deep cover for a single to get off the mark.
Length ball around off, Nabi taps it towards point.
WIDE! Well, the keeper went for the appeal this time as this good length ball goes down the leg side. Called wide instantly by the umpire. Probably trying to put pressure on the umpire.
WIDE! Back of a length ball but down the leg side. Nabi lets it go to the keeper.
Mohammad Nabi is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT & BOWLED! Afghanistan losing the plot here. From 75/0 to 80/3. Rahman gets the big fish Rahmanullah Gurbaz. He was looking good here but fails to convert the early life given by Mahmudullah. He looks to slog a good length delivery from Rahman but is early into the shot only to get a  leading edge. Rahman makes a loud call and goes for the catch. Bangladesh would be relieved that the drop earlier does not cause any major damage.
Good length ball outside off, Gurbaz looks to slam it over the long on fence but gets an inside edge and into the third man fence. Lucky runs.
On a fuller length and on off, Gurbaz plays it to covers.
On a length and on off, Zadran pushes it to mid off and gets to the other end.
Flatter one around off, pushed towards cover this time. Double wicket maiden from Afif to pull things right back for the hosts.
Najibullah Zadran is the new man in.

OUT! In the air.. and taken. Two wickets in the over. That wasn't needed from Afghan. Only the second ball and he tries to go big. He didn't get to the pitch of the delivery but went for the mighty hoick over the mid-wicket fence. He can't connect well as the ball balloons high in the air towards long on. Shanto settles under it and grabs it well.
Flatter one around off, Afghan blocks it towards the off side.
Asghar Afghan is the new man in for Afghanistan.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afif draws the first blood. He gets the timely breakthrough for the hosts. Zazai was living by the edge of the sword and he runs out of luck. Afif once again goes flatter  and Zazai looks to sweep but gets a top edge which is gobbled up by the man at short fine leg. Zazai walks back three short of a half ton.
Zazai gets beaten once again by the youngster as he looks to power the young bowler outside the park.
Flatter one outside off, Zazai looks to go for the slog but fails to get to the pitch of the ball.
Afif Hossain comes on now.
Floated one on middle, Zazai taps it towards mid off and takes a single.
On middle this time, Gurbaz looks to sweep but gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards point for a run.
Flatter one on middle, Zazai tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single this time.
Short ball on middle, Gurbaz works it towards long on for a single.
SIX! Innovative hit! Flatter one and outside off, Gurbaz reverse sweeps and connects well enough to maneuver it over the third man fence for a maximum.
Flatter  and outside off, Gurbaz goes for the cut but misses on it.
Mosaddek Hossain into the attack!
Shortish length around off, Gurbaz guides it towards third man for a single. 14 runs from this over.
Good length ball outside off this time, Zazai looks to power it through the off side but gets a thick inside edge onto the pads. The ball goes behind the stumps and they cross for a single.
SIX! Hammered! Short ball again on middle. Zazai is not going to miss out. He stands tall and deposits it over the deep square leg fence for a maximum this time.

Good length ball on middle, Gurbaz pushes it towards point and takes off for a quick single. A direct hit from the point fielder would've been exciting but the fielder misses his shy at the striker's end.
Another back of a length ball outside off, Zazai guides it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Through the gap between point and gully. Short ball outside off, Zazai works it through the gap between point and gully and into the third man fence. Nicely done.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl now.
Fuller one and on off, Gurbaz defends it onto the pitch.
Zazai cuts the flatter one through point and gets to the other end for a single.
WIDE! Shakib bowls one wide of off stump almost  close to tramline and the umpire signals it as a wide as Zazai fails to put bat on ball.
Flatter one outside off, Zazai pushes it to the man at covers.
Grubaz drives this flatter one down to mid on for a single.

SIX! Huge one from the man in form, Gurbaz skips down the track to this wide tossed up delivery from Shakib and lofts it up and over the long off fence for a six. The fielder at long off was a mere spectator as he watched the ball sail over him and into the fence.
Tossed up outside off, Gurtbaz defends it back to the bowler.

SIX! Whacked! Zazai into the groove now. On middle on a fullish length, he clears the front leg and hammers it sailing over the deep mid-wicket fence. An expensive start from Mahmudullah. 16 runs from the over. 42 from the Powerplay.
On middle, Zazai goes to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Slightly short ball, Zazai slaps it towards extra cover for a couple this time.
Goes for another heave but misses this time. This is darted on a fullish length around off, Zazai can't get bat on ball this time.
FOUR! Another boundary, this time over the head of the bowler. This is outside off, Zazai shuffles towards the leg side and hammers it over the bowlers head for another boundary.
FOUR! Crunched through the fence. Floated ball around off, bit of room on offer, Zazai goes back and drills it through extra cover and into the fence.
Mahmudullah into the attack now!
A single to end Shakib's over. This time Zazai punches the flatter one through covers and hares to the other end.
Another tosseed up delivery and another miss. Zazai is nowhere near the pitch of the ball as he goes for a wild swing.
Play and a miss! Zazai is unable to time the ball today. Shakib tosses one up outside off and Zazai looks to go downtown but cannot lay wood on ball.
Flatter one on the stumps, Zazai defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up and outside off, Zazai punches it to covers.
Flatter one around off, Zazai opens the face of the bat and runs it down to short third man.
Shakib Al Hasan into the attack.
Fuller ball this time, pushed towards mid off. 13 runs off the over.
Bumper this time, Gurbaz ducks under it.
FOUR! Another boundary. A good length ball closer to the body of Gurbaz. He has a poke but gets an outside edge to it. The ball goes wide of the keeper and into the third man fence.
On a fuller length, pushed towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Zazai. That wasn't from the middle of the bat. On middle, Zazai looks to deposit it over the square leg fence but the ball goes fine down the leg side of his inner half of the bat but good enough to get to the fence.
FOUR! Just helped it between cover-point. Around off on a good length, Zazai waits for the ball and opens the bat face at the last moment to get a boundary. Nicely done.
Fuller one and on off, Zazai drives it uppishly to mid on. The fielder dives forward but the ball drops just short of him. A single results in the end.
Short on middle, Gurbaz goes to pull but mistimes it in the air. The ball lands safely at mid-wicket and he gets a single this time.
A good delivery to the right hander. Saifuddin makes the ball to curve at the last moment and Gurbaz fails to lay bat on ball.

Zazai is living dangerously here. Saifuddin bowls on a length and on middle and Zazai looks to heave it on the leg side. But can manage only a thick inside edge which goes to  fine leg. A single taken.
On a fuller length and on middle, Zazai hammers it straight only to hit it at the stumps on the opposite end.
On a length and on middle, Gurbaz goes for a slog on the leg side but gets it off the inside half of the bat towards fine leg for a single.

Fuller ball around off, Zazai looks to power it over the cover fielder but can't get bat on ball. Excellent over from Shafiul. He should've had a wicket to his name but Mahmudullah made the mess of a simple chance.

DROPPED! Mahmudullah drops a sitter. This is a back of a length ball, Gurbaz goes to hammer it over the square leg fence but gets a top edge. The ball balloons high in the air towards fine leg. Mahmudullah settles under it but spills it. They take a single. How costly will this be for Bangladesh?
Beaten again! This time the ball is coming on, Gurbaz is desperate to feel the ball but the ball sneaks through the bat and pad.

Another heave attempt but not bat on the ball. This is on the fourth stump line, Gurbaz stands in his crease and looks to blast it towards the off side but can't pull it off. This is called wide as it is outside the tramline.
Slightly shortish, Gurbaz looks to block but gets an inside edge and onto the pads.
Beaten again! Good length ball around off, Gurbaz goes for another heave but is beaten by the away shape of the delivery. He is rooted to his crease and simply throwing his bat at the ball.
Shafiul starts with one on a good length. Gurbaz goes for a mighty heave but is beaten by the away movement.
Shafiul Islam to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! No he can't. This one is in the slot of Zazai and it is on the pads. He clears his front leg and heaves it towards the deep mid-wicket fence. First boundary of the over.
Slightly shortish, Zazai goes to pull but can't get bat on ball as he is hit high on the pads. Can he finish off the over well?
On middle this time, Zazai blocks it well towards mid on.
Another yorker on middle. Zazai jams it onto the pitch.
Good delivery to the left-hander this time. Good length ball around middle, Zazai blocks it towards cover.
Good yorker on the Free Hit. A full ball in the blockhole, Gurbaz can only push it towards mid off. He gets off the mark with a single.
NO BALL! A big one as well. Saifuddin starts with one around middle and leg on a good length, Gurbaz looks to work it down the leg side but gets hit on the pads.

We are all set for the action to begin! Out come the Afghanistan openers, Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Hazratullah Zazai make their way out to the middle. Mohammad Saifuddin will start the proceedings for the hosts. Here we go...

Rashid Khan says that it doesn't matter in T20I if one is batting first or second. Adds that they want to correct their mistakes they made in the last game. Affirms that the game is an important one and they would want to win and enter the finals with momentum. Rashid talking about the collapses, says that it is a part of the game but they would love to see the top order getting them some runs again. On his own bowling performance, Rashid says that he is happy with his bowling. Adds that he has been landing the balls in good areas and would love to continue doing that.

Shakib Al Hasan says that because of the grass on the surface, they will bowl first. Further adds they want to see if the bowlers can utilize that. The Bangladesh skipper mentions that the game is very important one as they want to go to Dhaka for the final with a win. Reveals that Islam is injured and Sabbir replaces him.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo starts by saying there has been lots of rain on the previous night and in the morning as well. Reckons the outfield can be slow because of the rain but the surface looks even and hard. Says it should be good for the batting. Informs there is moisture around because of the covering of the grass. Ends by saying win the toss and bat first.

Afghanistan Playing XI -  Hazratullah Zazai, Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Shafiqullah, Asghar Afghan, Mohammad Nabi, Najibullah Zadran, Gulbadin Naib, Rashid Khan (C), Karim Janat (IN FOR DAWLAT ZADRAN), Naveen-ul-Haq (IN FOR FAZAL NIAZAI), Mujeeb Ur Rahman.

Bangladesh Playing XI - Liton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Shakib Al Hasan (C), Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah, Sabbir Rahman (IN FOR AMINUL ISLAM), Mosaddek Hossain, Afif Hossain, Mohammad Saifuddin, Shafiul Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - We are all set for the Toss. Both the captains are out in the middle. Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Bangladesh. BANGLADESH OPT TO BOWL!

Welcome to the last league game between the two finalists of the Tri-series. Today's match gives both the teams an equal opportunity to prepare for the final shootout next week.  However, we might see both the sides tinker with their XI a little. The two sides though will be eager to head into the final with winning momentum. Rain could play a part in the later half, hence Toss could become a crucial factor. Let's hope the rain stays away and we get a cracker of a match. Do stay tuned for the Toss and team updates.
